scope: Verify mobile radius.all through the real Inspector, Canvas, draft Save, Editor reload, explicit Publish and inheritance reset for all 44 editable non-root PARTIAL types.

initial_regression.result: The first test run completed mobile Save and Publish, then failed when the fixture compared the Editor Canvas reset value to the different public class-based desktop border radius on a section node.
initial_regression.classification: Test assertion used the wrong baseline; no application defect. The fixture now records desktop Canvas and public CSS values separately.

coverage: All 44 editable non-root PARTIAL types expose radius.all -> responsive.set / borderRadius.
Distinct mobile all-corner radii render in Canvas and persist in the mobile Page Model after draft Save.
Draft Save leaves published mobile CSS unchanged; all saved values survive Editor reload.
Explicit Publish applies the expected computed mobile radius to all 44 public elements.
Mobile Publish leaves desktop public radius values unchanged.
Mobile reset restores the desktop Canvas breakpoint value; reset Save leaves public mobile CSS unchanged; separate Publish restores public desktop inheritance on mobile.
